name: Pharmaniaga Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售事项；主要事项为完成每5股合并为1股的股份合并、脱离PN17状况，以及派发中期股息。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长12.3%，净利润同比增长215.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, new business, reduction, or disposal of business segments in its announcements; the main events were the completion of a 5-into-1 share consolidation, upliftment from PN17 status, and payment of interim dividends. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue grew 12.3% year-on-year and net profit grew 215.5% year-on-year.
